items.exampleEn: The image on the screen is not clear.
Her answer was short and clear.
Are you certain about the time?
It is likely to rain tonight.
This hotel has single and double rooms.
items.exampleZh: 這家旅館有單人房和雙人房。

items.exampleEn: What material is this bag made of?
items.exampleZh: 這個包包是什麼材質做的？

items.exampleEn: This is a private room. Please don't come in.
items.exampleZh: 這是私人房間，請不要進來。

items.exampleEn: Chen is a common family name in Taiwan.

items.sentenceEn: It's likely to be cold tomorrow.

items.audioEn: This bag is made of a light material, so it's easy to carry.
items.audioZh: 這個包包是用很輕的材料做的，所以很好拿。

items.sentenceEn: I'm not certain, but I think so.

items.stemEn: Rain is very ____ in Taipei in winter.

items.passageEn: Helen wants to sell her old camera online. First, she takes a photo of it. The image is very clear, and she writes the details. The camera is made of a strong material, and it is likely to work for many more years. Soon, a man sends her a private message: "Are you certain it works well?" "Yes," she writes. "It has no problems at all."
items.passageZh: Helen 想在網路上賣掉她的舊相機。她先幫它拍照，照片很清楚，再寫下詳細資料。這台相機是用堅固的材料做的，很可能還可以用很多年。很快地，有一位男士傳私人訊息給她：「妳確定它很好用嗎？」她回覆：「是的，它完全沒有問題。」

items.promptZh: 我想要一間單人房，住三晚。
referenceEn: I'd like a single room for three nights.
I want a single room for three nights, please.
rubricZh: 「住三晚」可寫例如 for three nights
「我想要」可寫例如 I'd like、I want、Can I have

items.instructionZh: 用 common 造一個句子，說說在台灣很常見的一樣東西。
referenceEn: Convenience stores are very common in Taiwan.
Night markets are very common in Taiwan.
rubricZh: common 表示「常見的」，可放在 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 are common、a common food）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Convenience stores are、Rice is）
